cues: Stanza one opens with a confession.
She wanted to be what men wanted her to be, and that was only an attempt at life: a rough draft, not a life.
A game of hide and seek with her own being, in which she both hides and seeks.
Then, only four lines in, but: I was made of nows.
A coined plural: she is built of present moments, owing nothing to the past.
Her feet refuse to walk backwards and go forward, forward, mocking the ashes of what is burnt out, towards the kiss of new paths.
